name: plot_manhattan
description: Generate a Manhattan plot from GWAS summary statistics. Marks genome-wide (5e-8) and suggestive (1e-5) significance thresholds. Returns a high-resolution PNG.

parameters.sumstats_path: string — path to GWAS summary stats file (CSV/TSV with chr, pos, pval columns)

returns: dict with n_variants, n_significant, top_hits, output_files (PNG)
